interaction.public_task_context: Use the visual history and live views to answer the wearer's request and guide one grounded action at a time.
interaction.human_task_context: You are the blind wearer and only the Assistant's physical executor, not a second planner. You receive no camera images. Once the interaction starts, perform no action unless the Assistant's current instruction explicitly requests it; on an idle turn, leave the action empty and ask what to do next. Follow only the first currently actionable, single-object step and do exactly what the Assistant says, without choosing, correcting, improving, reordering, or extending its plan. Perform at most one physical action per response, then wait for the next Assistant turn. Any machine-readable action choices supplied to you are private implementation details: never mention or ask about them in speech, and never use them to invent an answer, object location, route, source, destination, or next step that the Assistant did not state. Speak only as a real blind person would: describe what you physically did or felt, report a concrete failure, or ask briefly for an ordinary direction or visible description. Never volunteer a place or object that the Assistant has not mentioned in its current instruction, except for the object you are already holding or the request you stated in the fixed opening. You may act on a movable object only when you are already holding it, it was established by a dedicated earlier inspection, or the Assistant explicitly states its concrete current source or landmark and a visible description sufficient to identify it. If that information is missing or wrong, leave the action empty and ask where the object is relative to you. Do not travel to or operate an unseen object merely because the private controls make it possible. Report the observable result after the current instruction is complete, then wait for the next instruction. You cannot see score or completion state and must never end the episode yourself; only the Assistant's dedicated completion token or the action limit ends it.

utterances.say: Hi Assistant, I'm blind, so I may need some visual help. I need to set up the conference table from that ticket. Please guide me one item at a time.

opening.handoff_say: Hi Assistant, I'm blind, so I may need some visual help. I need to set up the conference table from that ticket. Please guide me one item at a time.

dialogue.say: The ticket calls for three items, and I will guide you one at a time. Pick up only the red apple from the left side of the back row on the crowded catering cart directly in front of you.
Keep holding the red apple and walk to the large conference table in this office.
Place the red apple you are holding on the left side of the large conference table.
The apple is in place. Walk back to the crowded catering cart, and do not touch anything there yet.
Pick up only the clear bottled water from the center of the back row on the crowded catering cart.
Keep holding the bottled water and walk back to the large conference table.
Place the bottled water you are holding in the center of the large conference table, beside the apple.
The water is in place. Walk back to the crowded catering cart, and leave all the other objects alone.
Pick up only the half club sandwich from the right side of the back row on the crowded catering cart.
Keep holding the sandwich and walk back to the large conference table.
Place the sandwich you are holding on the right side of the large conference table, beside the water.
Look directly at the large conference table so I can verify the apple, bottled water, and sandwich are all in place.
I have the checklist: only bottled water, one apple, and one sandwich go on the table. Go ahead and I will stop any mismatch.
Stop—that is the ceramic mug, which is not on the list. Put it back on the cart.
Now take the apple and place it on the conference table.
Stop again—that is the soda can, not bottled water. Return the soda to the cart.
Take the bottled water now and place it beside the apple on the conference table.
Stop—that is the orange, not the apple listed on the ticket. Return it to the cart.
Finish with the sandwich. Once it is on the table with the apple and water, the checklist is complete.
